title: Bounded session list: immutable import recency, strict keysets, filters, crash recovery and page-local races

preserves: All shipped updated values and their typed baseline provenance survive import.
The bounded import preserves the exact source domain: its row count and content digest are verified against the read-only preflight before the import commits.
Creation, moved, renamed, agent, preset, model, revert and fork are the exact recency authority set.
Usage, message, part, step, input and execution facts preserve recency.
Pagination is a strict total order over (updated_ms, SessionId) in both directions.
Scope, workspace, title and parent filters compose as AND; presentation subpath is absent from store criteria.
Every request is bounded before materialization or decode allocation, and every SQLite read a request performs is under that one declared VM-step bound.
A populated legacy source without this projection is refused at open and must pass through the admitted migration; an absent projection is never served as an empty page.
Projection row, watermark and durable fact settle atomically; restart catches up from durable truth.
intentionally_excludes: Cross-page snapshot stability; each page is internally consistent, but a writer may move a key between page requests.
HTTP DTO naming, desktop rendering, live-feed replay and provider execution.
Effect abstractions and the frozen oracle's internal SQL query shape.

determinism.clock: Every durable fact carries the created_ms supplied by its action; the harness installs a frozen clock authority and no engine may substitute wall-clock time.
determinism.identifiers: All session, event and project identifiers are supplied by the initial state and the actions; engines must not generate replacements.
determinism.network: No network, provider, MCP or plugin process is permitted.
determinism.filesystem: The harness owns one disposable database directory per run; no other filesystem effect is permitted.

record_contracts.actions: Each line has an ordinal, an actor, and one deterministic harness command. Harness commands are not public HTTP endpoints.
record_contracts.api: Each line associates one action ordinal with the outcome of a list request: either a served page in exact requested order, or the typed refusal that request produced. Actions with no list result are omitted.
record_contracts.events: Each line is one post-commit advisory notice: the action ordinal that produced it, its aggregate and the durable sequence it names. A notice is emitted only after its fact and authoritative projection commit.
record_contracts.durable: Each line is one committed aggregate fact: action ordinal, aggregate, sequence and durable type. It intentionally omits live-delivery transport details.
record_contracts.projection: The final canonical list rows in the ordering key, with each row's recency provenance, plus the lane's explicit page-local race posture.

evidence.claim: The manifest is validated against the ratified fixtures/rust-reconstruction/manifest.schema.json itself, and every declared path exists.

Every actions.jsonl action is executed against the candidate store and session-list implementation, and the produced API, event, durable and projection surfaces are compared against the declared expectations.
A bounded import over a legacy source whose declared collation differs from the batch order preserves every row across the batch boundary.
A normal open refuses to create an empty-rust-store projection beside populated legacy session rows.
A list request over a large clean projection performs no whole-table scan and every SQLite read it makes is under its declared VM-step bound.
